lessons.title: Have you ever…?
lessons.summary: Говори об опыте без указания точного времени.

exercises.title: Present Perfect
exercises.explanation: Используй have или has плюс третью форму глагола, когда важен опыт или результат сейчас.

exercises.example: Have you ever tried surfing abroad?

exercises.prompt: Я никогда не был в Канаде.
exercises.canonicalAnswer: I have never been to Canada.

exercises.example: I haven't decided where to go yet.

exercises.canonicalAnswer: Have you sent the email yet?
acceptedAnswers: Have you already sent the email?

exercises.prompt: He has ___ started a new job.
Я потерял ключи, поэтому не могу войти.
exercises.canonicalAnswer: I have lost my keys, so I cannot get in.
acceptedAnswers: I've lost my keys, so I can't get in.
